inherited_audit.scope: Inherited successful original-only classfile/source/PC and Random audit. Public loading rechecks graph, trace, tape and file invariants without repeating that archive-dependent qualification.

provenance.root_semantics: Original project-owned fresh test roots and class-origin URLs are retained verbatim; native roots are independently chosen absolute paths. No captured path is opened during replay.
provenance.clock_semantics: Original epoch intervals and native clock inputs are retained verbatim. Each side validates its own measured intervals; replay never replaces a native clock with an original epoch.
